text: The PBOC held its H2 2026 work meeting, saying high-level financial opening is progressing steadily. It will optimize rules for corporate outbound lending, banks' overseas loans and cross-border RMB interbank financing. The central bank plans to introduce an offshore central-bank
text_zh: 中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议，表示金融高水平开放稳步推进。将优化企业境外放款、银行境外贷款和跨境人民币同业融资的相关规则。央行计划推出离岸央行——
